decisions.subject: O-28 option h-2 (MB-79 (h)): R-KV amended, a task numbers its preregs and the gate reads the landing task's newest of the record's increment: R-MA
decisions.recommendation: CARD-o28-prereg-name (~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-o28-prereg-name.answered.md); text from ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/MB-79/h/rule.md. Rule text: one file per pre-registered round of the task: `prereg-<MB-id>-<n>.json`, n = 1, 2, ... in the task's own order. For a record, the gate reads the landing task's prereg with the highest n (compared as an integer) among that task's preregs committed strictly before the commit that adds the record, whose `increment` equals the record's. At commit time the task is the task of the prereg added by HEAD's commit; so a landing's prereg is committed alone directly under the commit that adds its record, and that commit carries the `McBylaws-Task` trailer. At push and in CI it is the `McBylaws-Task` trailer of the commit that adds the record. A file not of the form `prereg-MB-<n>-<k>.json` is a rules source for arm C only while its task has no file of that form (a scope condition of arm C, not an exception).
